goal: Independently review the Phase 2 platformer greybox implementation for reachability, collision, fixed-height single jump, movement feel, timer/goal readability, and scope preservation.
forbidden_changes: implementation code changes or rework fixes
final art, enemy, item, scoring, camera polish, web export, double jump, wall jump, or dash decisions
Working, Canonical, or Policy Learning Card promotion

verify.name: Only authorized QA artifacts changed
verify.command: bash -lc 'extra=$(git status --short --untracked-files=all | sed "s/^...//" | grep -Ev "^(PHASE2_PLATFORMER_GREYBOX_PLAN.md|context/game_brief.md|work_packages/active/WP-2026W22-008.json|runs/RUN-20260528-005.json|research_notes/RN-2026W22-002-platformer-greybox-reference.md|work_packages/active/WP-2026W22-009.json|runs/RUN-20260528-006.json|art_notes/AN-2026W22-002-platformer-greybox-readability.md|work_packages/active/WP-2026W22-010.json|runs/RUN-20260528-007.json|owner_reviews/OR-2026W22-002-platformer-greybox-KR.md|work_packages/active/WP-2026W22-011.json|runs/RUN-20260528-008.json|work_packages/active/WP-2026W22-012.json|game/scenes/main.tscn|game/scripts/player.gd|runs/RUN-20260529-001.json|work_packages/active/WP-2026W22-013.json|reviews/RV-20260529-001.json|runs/RUN-20260529-002.json)$" || true); test -z "$extra"'

acceptance_criteria: QA independently reviews the implementation Run and changed target files without modifying implementation files.
QA checks reachability, gravity/floor collision, obstacle collision, fixed-height single jump, acceleration/friction feel, timer/goal readability, and excluded-scope preservation.
QA records pass, rework, or blocked in reviews/RV-20260529-001.json with actionable issues if needed.
QA verifies smoke-test cleanliness, scene runtime load, review schema, run schema, work-package schema, and changed-file scope.
QA does not claim final human playable-feel approval or Learning Card promotion.
notes: This Work Package authorizes QA review only. If QA finds implementation defects, it must record rework issues instead of editing Godot files.
